# Aviteus Business Solutions

> Aviteus Business Solutions Ltd runs the monthly finance work for UK owner-managed businesses, roughly 2 to 50 staff: bookkeeping, management accounts, payroll and pensions, VAT and year-end tax. Clients get a written scope, one named manager, and a short monthly "Done and due" report. Fees are fixed and agreed in writing before work starts. The first step is a free 20-minute review by video or phone.

Company number 16694378, registered in England and Wales, incorporated 4 September 2025. Registered office: 296 Kenton Road, Harrow HA3 8DD. Phone 020 4628 8209, Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm. Works with businesses across the UK by video, phone and email. Software: Xero, QuickBooks, Sage and FreeAgent.

Aviteus does not carry out statutory audits, business valuations or fundraising.

## Services

- [Bookkeeping and management accounts](https://www.aviteusbusiness.co.uk/services/bookkeeping): bank and card accounts reconciled to month end, bills and sales posted, a monthly management pack, a scope table of who does what.
- [Payroll and pensions](https://www.aviteusbusiness.co.uk/services/payroll): managed payroll, RTI submissions to HMRC, payslips, statutory pay, workplace pension auto enrolment, P60 and P11D.
- [VAT and year-end tax](https://www.aviteusbusiness.co.uk/services/vat-tax): VAT returns under Making Tax Digital, year-end accounts to Companies House, corporation tax and the CT600 return, with every deadline listed.
- [Self Assessment tax returns](https://www.aviteusbusiness.co.uk/services/self-assessment): personal tax returns for directors, landlords and the self-employed, filed before 31 January.
- [Business advisory](https://www.aviteusbusiness.co.uk/services/business-advisory): cash flow forecasts, budgets, pricing reviews, cost controls and getting figures ready for a lender. Aviteus does not raise funds or broker loans.
- [Company formation and compliance](https://www.aviteusbusiness.co.uk/services/company-formation): limited company set-up, HMRC registrations, Companies House filings and company secretarial tasks.
- [Accounting software set-up and training](https://www.aviteusbusiness.co.uk/services/accounting-software): Xero, QuickBooks, Sage and FreeAgent set-up, clean-up, record migration and training.
- [All services](https://www.aviteusbusiness.co.uk/services)

## Tools

- [UK tax deadline finder](https://www.aviteusbusiness.co.uk/deadline-finder): free, no sign-up. Shows the next 12 months of VAT, corporation tax, Companies House, PAYE, P60, P11D and Self Assessment dates, and exports them to a calendar.
